author: Valve
source: Native CS2 homepage idle clips extracted from the user's installed game on Windows
processing: All nonnegative native homepage idle samples;  Source inches converted to meters, Z up to Y up; world-space rotations calibrated to each bundled agent rifle reference. Source wpn attachment retained relative to retargeted right hand, without weapon bounding-box placement. Source 1 CT retarget removed; the shared native Source 2 pose layer is used by both teams.
limitations: Native graph idle layering and SnapWeapon graph evaluation are not reproduced. Static scale channels are restored from the compiled clips; native root vertical motion is verified as zero. Clips loop at their decoded final key; final native graph sequencing is not reproduced. This is not a capture of the final game UI graph.
